description: Network control utility for managing local service routing and Let's Encrypt TLS ingress.

NETCTL_DIR.description: Root directory of the netctl component.

NETCTL_STATE_FILE.description: Path to the active netctl JSON state file.

NETCTL_BOOTSTRAP_HTTP_ONLY.description: Internal flag (0 or 1) to emit port 80 HTTP-only Nginx configuration during initial ACME HTTP-01 challenge bootstrap.

CERT_STORE_DIR.description: Persistent read-only directory on attached storage for storing Let's Encrypt certificates across VM recreations.

LETSENCRYPT_EMAIL.description: Contact email address for Let's Encrypt ACME registration.

LETSENCRYPT_RENEW_BEFORE_SECONDS.description: Remaining validity threshold in seconds passed to openssl x509 -checkend before renewing a certificate (0 = renew only when expired).

NETCTL_PROXY_SEND_TIMEOUT.description: Upstream proxy send timeout in seconds (e.g., 300 or '300s').

NETCTL_PROXY_READ_TIMEOUT.description: Upstream proxy read timeout in seconds for long-running LLM/SSE endpoints (e.g., 300 or '300s').

NETCTL_PROXY_BUFFERING.description: Whether upstream proxy response buffering is enabled ('on'/'off' or boolean).
